t: This Milwaukee Tri-Lobe Mixed VDE Screwdriver Set is designed for safe electrical work, providing essential tools for professional electricians and DIYers undertaking electrical installations. The VDE-tested tools are certified to 10,000 volts, ensuring safe use up to 1,000 volts. Featuring chrome vanadium molybdenum steel blades, the set offers durability and precision. A slim shank diameter allows easy access to low-lying screw applications, while the comfortable tri-Lobe handle is optimised for maximum user comfort and high-torque performance. Permanent, clearly visible ID markings enable quick tool identification, and an anti-roll three-sided collar prevents the tools from rolling. An integrated lanyard hole allows secure attachment to a safety system. The 5-piece set includes PZ1, PZ2, SL3, SL4 screwdrivers, and voltage tester for added safety.
b: Slim Shank Diameter Accesses Low-Lying Screws
